name: Permission dialog
oneLiner: a glass system dialog rises over the dimmed brand page with the brand tile and the thing it wants (calendar, files, inbox...) side by side, a fingertip taps Allow, the waiting dots between the two tiles fuse into a green link, a check lands on the resource and the buttons give way to a green Connected state
say: when the speaker says they gave the tool access or connected it to something ('you just let it into your calendar', 'connect your inbox and...'): the tap lands on 'allow' or 'connect', the green Connected on the payoff
